name: Limited Structural Repairs for Seventh and Marshall Garage
displayName: Limited Structural Repairs for Seventh and Marshall Garage
summary: The City of Richmond is accepting bids for select repairs of the parking garage located at 607 E. Marshall Street in Richmond, Virginia. Repairs include, but are not limited to, partial and full depth concrete slab repairs, concrete beam repairs, concrete column repairs, and repairs to existing pedestrian guard barrier cables.

name: IFB - 270000890 - Hobby Hill Lake Dam Rehabilitation
displayName: IFB - 270000890 - Hobby Hill Lake Dam Rehabilitation
summary: The City of Richmond, Virginia (the "City"), on behalf of the Department of Public Utilities ("DPU"), seeks bids from qualified firms to provide general contracting services for the Hobby Hill Lake Dam Rehabilitation project (the "Project"). The Project will entail the removal and replacement of the dam and principal outlet structure, as well as the stabilization of seepage through the dam using a blanket, chimney, and foundation drain (the "Work"). The Work, more particularly described below in the Statement of Work, also includes demolition of existing hydraulic structures, maintenance of buffer zone of dam slopes, construction of the new dam, roadway elements, and associated spillway and drainage structures.

name: WTP Sanitary Sewer System Improvements
summary: The City of Richmond, Virginia (the "City"), on behalf of the Department of Public Utilities ("DPU"), seeks bids from qualified firms to provide construction services at the City's Water Treatment Plant (“WTP”). The Project will entail replacement of the sanitary sewer pump system, gravity piping, grinders, force main, and heat tracing on the force main, as well as installation of a new sump pump to empty the secondary containment area (the "Work"). Specific details regarding the nature and prosecution of the Work are provided in the Statement of Work.

name: Patterson Ave Bike Lanes Phase II
displayName: Patterson Ave Bike Lanes Phase II
summary: The City of Richmond is accepting bids for the construction of the Patterson Ave Bike Lanes phase II (UPC 125349) project. The project aims to provide for the installation of pavement markings and signs to provide on-street buffered bike lanes along the Patterson Ave corridor from Commonwealth Ave to Willow Lawn Dr.

name: Transportation Systems Maintenance & Emergency Services Annual Contract
displayName: Transportation Systems Maintenance & Emergency Services Annual Contract
summary: The City of Richmond is soliciting bids to establish term contracts with one or more experienced contractors to provide construction, maintenance, emergency response, and technical support services. Services may include, but are not limited to, installation of traffic signal foundations; span wire, mast arm, and pedestal signal poles; electrical conduits; traffic signal and fiber optic cabling; junction boxes; communications equipment; traffic signal cabinets and controllers; signal heads; countdown pedestrian signal heads; vehicle and pedestrian detection systems; flashers; and other transportation-related equipment as required by the City.

name: E. Broad St over Abandoned Railroad Spur Bridge Superstructure Replacement
displayName: E. Broad St over Abandoned Railroad Spur Bridge Superstructure Replacement
summary: The City of Richmond is accepting bids for the replacement of the superstructure of the existing structurally deficient bridge carrying East Broad Street (US 250) over the CSX Transportation (CSXT) right-of-way (UPC No. 118541). The project includes, but is not limited to, the removal and replacement of bridge superstructure, repair/replacement of sidewalks, curbing, pavement markings, signs, maintenance of traffic, erosion and sediment control, and lighting. The project encompasses existing roadway and bridge infrastructure and is located within existing right-of-way. Improvements to the bridge will be completed above grade and will require minimal ground disturbance.
